name: std::isxdigit
intro:
Checks if the given character is a hexadecimal numeric character (0123456789ABCDEFabcdef).

The behavior is undefined if the value of ch is not representable as unsigned char and is not equal to EOF.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: Non-zero value if the character is a hexadecimal numeric character, zero otherwise.

sections.title: Notes
